name: regression-impact
description: Analyze the impact of a proposed change on requirements, design, contracts, code, tests and operations.
---

# Regression Impact

For the proposed change, identify affected requirements, ACs, design docs, ADRs, contracts, code modules, database migrations, provider adapters, tests and operational runbooks. Select a risk-based regression set. Identify backwards compatibility and rollback. Do not change approved baselines without a change request and explicit approval.
